projects.name: Dekko
projects.desc: Helps a reviewer understand a pull request before reading the diff.
did: A typed change model with line-level citations, so each claim points at code.
A deterministic diagram renderer for the shape of the change.
An automated grader for answers about the change.
Built in two days with an agent-driven ticket workflow: 87 commits, test-first, stacked PRs.

projects.name: Skills Marketplace
projects.desc: Agent Skills (SKILL.md files) for Claude and other AI agents, published in one place.
did: Reusable instructions packaged as SKILL.md files.
Written for Claude and usable by other agents.

projects.name: Mero Pasal
projects.desc: Turns a Kathmandu kirana shop’s paper bills into a searchable digital bill book.
did: Works on a phone as a progressive web app (PWA).
Replaces the drawer of paper bills with something you can search.

projects.name: Chroma Rush
projects.desc: A colour-matching endless runner in Godot 4.
did: Used CrazyGames player metrics (playtime, return rate) to find where players left.
Shipped update 1.0.1: new players start on the road, calmer screen shake, a free shield and a gentler first minute.
